title: Xiaomi Mi Pad 5 Android 13 Update Install & Complete Walkthrough
blurb: The Xiaomi Mi Pad 5 on Android 13 — installing the update on the tablet and walking through what you're looking at once it's done.
video_description:
The Xiaomi Mi Pad 5 on Android 13 — installing the update on the tablet and walking through what you're looking at once it's done.

Tablets don't get the same attention as phones, and that's exactly why this one gets asked about every week. The Mi Pad 5 is still a great screen and a solid media machine, and an Android update is the difference between it feeling current and feeling forgotten. In this clip I take the tablet through the update and then give you a proper look around: the home screens, the settings, the layout, and the feel of it in the hand after the jump.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi Mi Pad 5 (nabu)
🤖 Update  : Android 13

🎬 In This Clip
• The Mi Pad 5 running Android 13
• The update going onto the tablet
• The first boot and the home screens after it
• Settings and the layout you'll be living in
• Why people keep asking for this update on the Pad 5

❓ Common Questions
Q: Is this for the Mi Pad 5 or the Pad 5 Pro? A: This is the Mi Pad 5 / Xiaomi Pad 5, codename nabu.
Q: Will an update wipe my data? A: A normal update doesn't. Flashing manually can, so check before you do it.
Q: Should I back up anyway? A: Yes. Every time. No exceptions.
Q: Will my apps keep working? A: They should. Open the heavy ones first and see.
Q: Does this affect my warranty? A: The normal update path doesn't.
